name: FLUX.2 Klein 9B FP8 / Klein 4B FP8
notes: NVIDIA/BFL RTX AI Garage blog (Aug 6). Klein 9B FP8 ~15 GB on RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB; Klein 4B FP8 ~8 GB. 40% VRAM reduction, 40% throughput gain vs BF16. Pure precision upgrade — download FP8 checkpoint, select fp8_e4m3fn in Load Diffusion Model node. No workflow changes.

name: PrunaVAED — Pruned+Distilled VAE Decoder for LTX-2.3
notes: Open-sourced Jul 28; landed in ComfyUI v0.30.0 Aug 3. 1.7-2.1x faster decode, ~50% lower peak VRAM in decode phase. Encoder and latent format unchanged — true drop-in. Place prunavae_ltx23.safetensors in models/vae/; ComfyUI-LTXVideo nodes auto-detect.

name: SAM 3.1 Multiplex
notes: Checkpoint drop-in (same node format as SAM3). Joint multi-object tracking: processes up to 16 objects in one forward pass (vs one per object in SAM3.0). 7x throughput speedup at high object count, FPS doubles. Native ComfyUI PR #13408 merged Apr 27.

name: Lucida — BiRefNet fine-tune for transparent objects
notes: Bundled in ComfyUI-RMBG v3.1.0 (Jul 21). MIT license. Transparent-object recall: 0.31 -> 0.98 in test suite. Handles glass, dragonfly wings, camouflage, text/logos, glow/VFX, line art. Update RMBG node to v3.1.0 via ComfyUI Manager; select Lucida in node dropdown.

name: BEN2 — Background Erase Network 2 (Confidence Guided Matting)
notes: Bundled in ComfyUI-RMBG v3.1.0. Two-stage: coarse mask -> low-confidence-pixel refinement. Stronger on fine hair, 4K, semi-transparent edges. Same node update as Lucida; select BEN2 for portrait/hair subjects.

name: ReActor v0.6.2 + HyperSwap 256 ONNX models
notes: Doubles swap face resolution: 128x128 (Inswapper) -> 256x256 (HyperSwap). Drop-in: place hyperswap_1c_256.onnx in models/hyperswap/; select in ReActor node. Minor known bug on certain CPU float configs (GitHub #208/#183) — test before production. Also adds ReActorRestoreFaceAdvanced node targeting only swapped region.

name: ComfyUI-QwenVL-Mod v2.4 (Qwen3.5-VL support + SageAttention)
notes: Community fork of ComfyUI-QwenVL. Adds Qwen3.5-VL auto-detect, local model discovery (GGUF/HF models in models/ dir auto-appear), SageAttention with arch-aware kernels + SDPA fallback. Use Qwen3.5-VL-7B GGUF Q4_K_M (~6-8 GB) to stay within 16 GB. Backward-compatible with Qwen2.5-VL weights.

name: HiDream-O1-Image Dev FP8 — Unified t2i + instruction edit
notes: 8B Pixel-level Unified Transformer. Supports t2i, instruction-based image editing, and subject-driven personalization in one model. FP8 Dev ~10 GB at 2048x2048. Native ComfyUI support (PR #13817). New builder build_hidream_edit needed — different sampler chain. Additive, not supersession of existing builders.

name: ComfyUI-Darkroom — 161 film stocks + reference Color Match
notes: 58-node suite. 161 film stock profiles (Capture One curve data), 35 spectral neg×print LUTs, 102 lens profiles, physics-based H&D curves, grain, halation. Also includes reference-driven Color Match node. Zero VRAM overhead. Confirm license before production use.

name: ComfyUI-VideoColorGrading — Neural 3D LUT from reference (kijai)
notes: Generates a 3D color LUT from a reference image using two-stage diffusion. Applies temporally consistently across video sequences. Stronger than static HALD LUT for video color matching. ~4-6 GB VRAM for LUT generation.

name: ComfyUI Native SUPIRApply Node (PR #13250)
notes: Same SDXL-based SUPIR checkpoints; native implementation eventually retires kijai/ComfyUI-SUPIR custom node. New node name: SUPIRApply. GLVControl, ZeroSFT, ZeroCrossAttn modules included. Test node-name differences before migrating away from custom node.

name: ComfyUI-PuLID-Flux-Chroma — PuLID with Chroma/FLUX.1 support
notes: First PuLID implementation with full Chroma model support. Stronger identity lock than IP-Adapter FaceID on Flux backbone. Requires Flux.1 or Chroma base already loaded. Workflow rebuild needed (not a node swap). Test with build_klein_headswap for Klein 9B compatibility.

name: ComfyUI-facerestore_advanced (flickleafy) — quality-assessment wrapper
notes: Quality-assessment refactor of facerestore_cf: 15+ metrics (SSIM, artifact detection, color bleeding, geometric distortion), auto-fallback chain (CodeFormer → GFPGAN → GPEN), fine-grained fidelity control. Additive install. Young project (8 commits) — assess maintenance status.

name: Portrait Engine FLUX / FLUX 2 Klein LoRA v4.0
notes: Trained specifically on FLUX.2 Klein 9B (also compatible FLUX.1/Z-Image). Adds photorealistic skin texture, pore detail, natural lighting. Standard LoRA drop-in; weight 0.6-0.8 recommended to avoid over-sharpening. Civitai account required to download.

name: ComfyUI v0.30.0 Save Video CRF Node
notes: Native node in ComfyUI v0.30.0 (Aug 3). Adds CRF (Constant Rate Factor) quality parameter to video output. Also useful in build_video_upscale. Platform update — no separate install.

name: FLUX 3 Image (Black Forest Labs)
notes: FLUX 3 announced Jul 23 but NO open weights as of Aug 7. API/early access only. 20.4B DiT + Mistral-class VL encoder. Dev open-weight expected 'later 2026' (precedent: FLUX.2 took 5 months from announce to HF drop). Monitor https://github.com/black-forest-labs/flux2. Would supersede Flux.1 backbone in build_txt2img etc.

name: MoGe-3 — Fine-Detail Monocular Geometry Estimation (Microsoft Research)
notes: Paper published Jul 21. Self-Guided Sparse Volumetric Refinement (SSR) for sharper fine-detail geometry vs MoGe-2. Code and weights 'coming soon' on GitHub. Will be Tier 1 drop-in when released (ComfyUI-MoGe2 node format compatible). Monitor github.com/microsoft/moge weekly.

name: WAN 3.0 (Alibaba) — API-only as of 2026-08-07
notes: Public API beta launched Aug 6 on Alibaba Cloud. 4K, 30-second clips, built-in audio. CONFIRMED no open weights on HuggingFace, Wan-Video GitHub, or ModelScope as of Aug 7. Many sites falsely claim open weights exist — do not act on those. WAN 2.2 remains the open-weight SOTA. Monitor Wan-AI HuggingFace org weekly.

name: FLUX 3 Video (BFL) — Partner Nodes only
notes: Available in ComfyUI v0.30.2 (Aug 5) via Partner Nodes only — API-based, no self-hosted checkpoint. Up to 20-second clips with native audio. VRAM unknown; likely exceeds 16 GB. Not integrable into self-hosted spellcaster without BFL partnership. Monitor for open-weight Dev release.

name: Hunyuan 3D 3.0/3.1 (Tencent) — Partner Nodes
notes: 3D-DiT hierarchical sculpting architecture (3x geometric resolution vs 2.x). Multi-view input (2-4 views). 3D Parts Decomposition. Partner-node install required. Architectural break from Hunyuan3D 2.x — full re-test of both builders needed. 16 GB VRAM feasible for standard mesh; large textured output may need tiling.

name: LTX-2.3 Spatial Upscaler x2 v1.1 (Lightricks)
notes: Latent-space spatial upscaler for LTX-2.3. Doubles resolution inside two-stage pipeline before VAE decode. ~1 GB model. Viable at 1024x576 on 16 GB (tight); 1080p output requires 24 GB. Better temporal consistency than frame-level upscaling. Requires pipeline rework (add upscale stage between diffusion and decode).

name: SeedVR2 v2.5 — One-Step Video Restoration (ByteDance, ICLR 2026)
notes: Architectural supersession of SeedVR (CVPR 2025). One-step diffusion transformer vs multi-step. 3B FP16 ~8-10 GB; 3B GGUF Q4 ~6-7 GB; 7B with BlockSwap 12-14 GB on 16 GB card. Native ComfyUI core support (PR #14424). v2.5 is modular redesign. Mixed FP8 variants fix 7B artifacts. Pipeline rework needed for build_seedv2r.

name: InstantRestore (Snap Research) — single-step personalized face restoration
notes: Single-step image diffusion model + attention sharing for fast personalized face restoration. No ComfyUI node confirmed as of Aug 7. Monitor for community wrapping. Could supersede CodeFormer for identity-preserving restoration when integrated.

name: MiniMax H3 (Hailuo 3.0) — 33B omni-modal video
notes: CRITICAL: License explicitly EXCLUDES EU, UK, US, South Korea from local open-weight deployment. User (France = EU) CANNOT legally use open weights. Even if legal: 45+ GB system RAM required, 12.2-15.3 GB VRAM with full offloading. New builder would be build_minimax_video. Mark as legal blocker — do NOT integrate without legal sign-off.

name: Topaz Bloom 2 + Wonder 3.5 (ComfyUI Partner Nodes)
notes: Commercial license required (Topaz AI account). Bloom 2 targets AI-generated imagery (face enhancement sub-feature). Wonder 3.5 targets photographic/realistic content. Partner-node install via ComfyUI-Manager. Drop-in post-process; run as sequential pass after freeing generation VRAM.

name: Eyeline-Labs ID-V2V — identity-preserving video restylization
notes: SIGGRAPH Asia 2026. Wan2.1-I2V-14B-720P fine-tune for video restylization with strict identity preservation. Apache 2.0. 24 GB minimum (CPU offload), 34 GB full-GPU. INCOMPATIBLE with RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB. Monitor for quantised/distilled variant. New builder build_idv2v_video when VRAM-compatible version available.

name: NTIRE 2026 Real-World Face Restoration Challenge — published methods
notes: CVPR 2026 Workshop. Top methods beat CodeFormer on perceptual quality. Research code only — no ComfyUI node yet. Dominant trend: one-step diffusion priors. Monitor for community wrapping into ComfyUI within 30-60 days given 2025-2026 pipeline speed.
